GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

6. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

7. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

15. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
